faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Balasore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the District Court Balasore Recruitment 2026 is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the District Court Balasore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 48 vacancies are available for the posts of Junior Clerk & Copyist, Stenographer Gr.-III, and Junior Typist in the District Court Balasore Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years for all the posts. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a +3 examination or equivalent, a Diploma in Computer Application, and proficiency in Odia. Specific typing and shorthand skills are required for Stenographer and Typist posts.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by the District Court Balasore.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the District Court Balasore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Shorthand & Typewriting Test (for relevant posts), a Computer Science Test (Practical), and a Viva Voce Test.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per Level-4 (Rs.19,900-63,200/-) for Junior Clerk & Copyist and Junior Typist, and Level-7 (Rs.25,500-81,100/-) for Stenographer Gr.-III.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the District Court Balasore Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Court Balasore, which is http://balasore.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the application form.
